title: Feature plan
description: Mutable planning metadata beside immutable feature.json. Git preserves history. An absent plan uses built placement for compatibility.

priority.description: Lower positive numbers come first; zero or omission means unranked.

milestone.description: Canonical milestone URN. Legacy free-text milestones remain readable.

labels.description: References to shared label records in this Saga.

archived.description: Hide the feature from feature lists and coverage gaps while keeping every record. Status is preserved for restore.

archived_reason.description: Why the feature was archived. Requires archived.
